Required 4 is closed by mechanism. In realizations.py:729-801 (validate_generated), groups are keyed by each overlay identity, plus the host URN when there is no canonical_home. Any transclusion that leaves a group undecided gets a local j:declare whose first reading is true. In every wording_variants entry, readings[0] is the earlier printing, equal to 'printed'. A caller that decides only part of a group raises an error. printing_guards also raises if a kohanim_appendix feature is selected outside its attested caller. For both part and whole-host targets, an original context therefore resolves to the earlier printing. actual-original-printing-defaults.json reports exact earlier words and no appendix options for all four hosts.
